The approach

Why this isn't another AI shop.

Anyone with a subscription can generate video — and audiences can already smell it. The moat is the hybrid: real hero footage that grounds every frame, then AI to do what a solo crew never could. Craft first, scale second.

A filmmaker's eye

Story, framing, taste, restraint — the things AI can't fake. Every concept is built on a single-minded idea, then directed, not just generated.

Directed, not prompted

Real footage at the core

Real hero shots — product macros, real light, real motion, captured on location. The grounding layer that keeps AI's weak spots off screen.

Shot for real

AI for scale & speed

Impossible worlds, endless ad variations, new angles, backgrounds and languages — multiplied from one shoot, finished and graded in days.

Worlds · variations · turnaround

How we work

One repeatable pipeline.
Days, not weeks.

The same five moves on every job — which is exactly how the turnaround stays fast and the quality stays high.

1

Brief & concept

A sharp, single-minded idea first — the difference between a video and an ad that works.

2

Shoot the hero

Real footage on FX30 / X5 / iPhone — the grounded, cinematic foundation.

3

Extend with AI

Multiply angles, variations, backgrounds and languages from the hero shot.

4

Edit & grade

Cut, scored and colour-graded to a finished, platform-ready standard.

5

Deliver

In days — in every format and aspect ratio you need to ship.

What you get

Not one video.
A reusable asset package.

Every project hands back more than a clip — and every project makes the next one start faster.

Hero + cut-downs

One signature spot, plus 9:16, 1:1 and 16:9 versions ready for every placement.

Variations to test

Multiple edits and hooks, so your media spend always has something to optimise against.

Multi-language versions

Hindi, Marathi, English & more — one shoot, many markets, India to global.

Source assets, yours

Stills, prompts and project files — kept, so the next campaign builds on this one.

What I make

Six ways to put video to work.

From a single scroll-stopping product ad to a monthly content engine. Start with one — scale into a retainer.

★ Start here
🛍️

Product Ads (D2C)

Short, punchy product videos for Meta, Instagram & TikTok — built to stop the scroll and sell.

Deliver: 1 hero (15–30s) + 3 platform cut-downs (9:16, 1:1, 16:9).
⚡

UGC Variations at Volume

Many ad variants from one brief, so performance marketers can test fast. Sells speed and volume.

Deliver: packs of 5 / 10 / 20 variants from a single brief.
🎵

Music & Lyric Videos

Narrative, mood and visual storytelling for independent musicians and labels.

Deliver: 1 full video (2–4 min) or a lyric-video pack.
🎬

Brand Films & Founder Stories

The premium hybrid anchor — real footage, AI-extended, scripted and graded.

Deliver: 60–90s brand film — scripted, shot, AI-extended, graded.
🏝️

Real-Estate & Hospitality Reels

Walkthroughs and destination reels for hotels, homestays, realtors and resorts.

Deliver: 1 property/venue reel (30–60s) + cut-downs.
🔁

Monthly Content Retainer

A predictable package of videos every month — the stability play for brands that post constantly.

Deliver: 4–8 short videos / month, fixed scope.
